name: Can I add a bathroom or kitchen to my custom basement design?

mainEntity.name: Can I add a bathroom or kitchen to my custom basement design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, adding a bathroom or kitchen to your custom basement design is often possible and can significantly enhance the functionality and value of the space, especially if creating an in-law unit or a self-contained apartment. This typically involves extending existing plumbing and electrical systems, and may require specific permits. Our team can assess the feasibility and requirements during the design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Adding a bathroom or kitchen to a custom basement is possible, enhancing functionality but requiring plumbing, electrical work, and permits.
